text:
Marisa: Quick idea — instead of persisting full request/response when our PII detector fires, capture a small 'sensitive snippet' (e.g., 128 chars around the token), store an HMAC'd fingerprint, and keep only lightweight metadata for console/debugging. Thoughts?

AJ: I like it. Does snippet size let us repro user issues though? need a link to full request id or a replay token to rehydrate when legal/Audit approves. :thinking_face: 

Devon: Snippet can still be identifying. Must be tenant-salted HMAC + KMS key rotate plan. Also recommend capture_on_error_only flag so we don't store snippets for every successful call. 

Sree: Console UX: show "sensitive snippet" collapsed by default with a CTA "Request access" that triggers audit log + approver flow. TTL 30 days and then auto-purge. For canary, gate behind feature-flag `sensitive_snippet_inspect`. 

Hannah: Cost note — indexing even small snippets across high-volume routes could blow storage/ES costs. Suggest sampling (1% baseline) and increase for errored requests or canary tenants. Also cap snippet length to 128 bytes. 

Devon: Agreed on sampling. Also add a field `capture_reason` (e.g., pii_detected | error | manual_inspect) so we can filter telemetry. Must document retention and legal constraints clearly. 

Marisa: Draft config for platform folks — open to suggestions: 
```yaml
logging:
  sensitive_snippet_sampler:
    enabled: true
    sample_rate: 0.01 # 1% by default
    capture_on_error_only: true
    snippet_length: 128
    hmac_key_id: "projects/redwood/keyrings/logging/keys/snippet-hmac"
    ttl_days: 30
    store_fingerprint_only: true
    capture_reason_whitelist: ["pii_detected", "trace_failure"]
```

AJ: Nice. We should also add `max_per_request: 3` to avoid chats with tons of emails spamming storage. 

Sree: Console display mock: show redacted snippet like `...4d3f****...` with badge `PII snippet · 30d left` and an audit link. No free-text search over snippet contents unless auditor role. 

Devon: Security checks: deterministic HMAC per-tenant, KMS-backed key, log rotate plan, and a backfill cleanup script that re-hashes legacy entries. Also need a policy for legal hold (exempt TTL). 

Hannah: Metrics to watch during rollout: snippet_store_rate, avg_snippet_per_request, storage_bytes_monthly, reviewer_approval_latency. Set alerts if storage growth > 15%/week. 

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for feature-flag `sensitive_snippet_inspect` to 5% of production traffic at 2026-03-20T15:02:30Z. 

Marisa: Action items: Devon -> write RFC with HMAC details & KMS rotation; Hannah -> quick cost estimate & sampling sim; Sree -> console mockups + approver flow; AJ -> add replay token flow for legal repro. I'll own the canary rollout plan. 

Devon: I'll include unit tests for classifier threshold and a small script to simulate snippet leakage scenarios. 

AJ: If we do capture_on_error_only + 1% sampling baseline we should be fine for initial ramp. Also add an opt-in tenant override for supported enterprise customers. 

Marisa: Cool — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a PR for the config and a short RFC template later today. :rocket:
